title: RAW one whole cross-leaf extension selected only by frozen powder-reading coverage
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_EXECUTED. Preserve all65 primary whole values and15 explicit alternate-form assumptions of the complete f21r/f32v powder-partition reading. Pair only identical complete ZL/IT locus lists outside physical leaves21/32; count every owned GDT928 paragraph, choose exactly one qualifying pair by fixed lexical-cost rank, and attempt one complete shared extension. This is bounded exploratory development, not a semantic score or an automatic reopening of GDT994.

design.mechanism: A whole reading becomes less freely fitted when the same literal values, semantic types, nineteen productions, material ancestry and scope obligations must survive on an additional complete physical leaf. Selection uses frozen surface coverage, never fluency, guessed topic, similarity or a favorable material consequence.
design.unit: One paired complete ZL3b/IT2a paragraph with exactly the same ordered physical locus list; all other source rows and rejection reasons remain in the denominator.
design.contrast: A shared whole-lexicon continuation with explicit multi-step material references versus a fresh local glossary, arbitrary role switches, or an unfinished alignment. Only the former is development progress; none independently confirms meanings.
design.prediction: If a complete selected paragraph forces an already fixed Operation to function solely as an incompatible nominal, needs a changed material identity or makes two fully bound clauses contradict the same preserved semantic contract, the proposed whole extension fails. An open word or unbound scope is MISSING_BINDING, not a proven contradiction. A complete coherent reading is conditional exploratory transfer, not confirmation.

sources.claim: Exact immutable65-value lexicon,15 alternate forms,19 productions, two whole readings, rivals and scope/quantity assumptions.
Owned f84-free complete paragraph population; no content opened for this proposal.
Prior47-word transfer covered only its fitted original among1349paragraph rows; remaining rows were missing lexical capacity, not contradictions.
Earlier f29v/f32v partial recipe drafts; old changes and open material links do not supply current word meanings.

freeze.all_parent_values_and_types: All65 primary values and all15 declared alternate forms remain exactly as parent, including uncertain raw entities and whole forms. No fuzzy match, stem expansion, spacing normalization, borrowed family values or automatic synonym.
freeze.constructions: All19 parent productions and fixed semantic contracts remain. Existing CARRY/FRESH, ADD/reiterated and equal-portions rivals remain distinct, not silently combined.
freeze.operation_count: Distinct denotations from the preceding fixed list, including an operation explicitly encoded inside a declared compound. ACQUIRE, THEN, UNTIL, tools, properties and nouns do not count. Synonymous spellings of DRY count once.

selection_contract.population: All1349GDT928complete paragraph rows previously counted by994:659ZL and690IT. Reconcile source identity and population before selecting; discrepancy is INPUT_MISMATCH, not a corrected target count. RF has no own complete paragraph contract.
selection_contract.exclusions: Exclude every side, subpanel and paragraph of physical leaves21 and32. f84/f84r/f116v remain closed. Historical exposure of all remaining rows remains; these are not virgin holdouts.
selection_contract.pairing: Pair a ZL and IT paragraph only when their entire ordered physical line/locus list is identical. No clipping, joining adjacent paragraphs, or union made into a new paragraph. Unpaired rows remain reported.
selection_contract.literal_eligibility: Both entire paragraphs must have every source line anchor_eligible=true. One uncertain line disqualifies the whole pair as SOURCE_UNCERTAIN; do not remove individual groups or substitute a reader. All raw forms still counted for the complete rejection table.
selection_contract.counts: Known means exact membership in the frozen65+15surface inventory. Unknown type means exact raw surface outside it. Count occurrences and distinct types separately for each whole reader; never pool readers to pass a bound.
selection_contract.rank: Among pairs satisfying every bound, sort by max(ZLunknownTypes,ITunknownTypes) ascending, then min(ZLknownPositions/ZLgroups,ITknownPositions/ITgroups) descending using exact rational comparison, then min(ZLknownTypes,ITknownTypes) descending, then natural physical folio/panel order, recto before verso, numerical first locus and complete numerical locus tuple. Exact unresolved rank collision is a stop requiring a declared source-key rule before content opening.
selection_contract.selection: Exactly the first qualifying pair, or NO_CAPACITY. No second candidate after a failed or inconvenient reading. No lower gates, alternative rank or same-pass rerun.
selection_contract.output: Every1349row with identity, pair status, source flags, counts and every applicable rejection reason; every eligible pair with rank; at most one selected pair. Census outputs counts and identifiers first, no unrelated paragraph text dump.

post_selection_development_contract.target_opening: Only after a separately approved preregistered census decision, open the selected entire pair. Preserve all raw groups, separators, uncertain readings and whole alternate counterversions. RF may be preserved as a locus-aligned counterversion if owned, never assigned an invented independent paragraph contract.
post_selection_development_contract.new_word_cost: At most20new types per selected reader and at most40in their union; any spelling shared across readers receives one identical value/type. New words must contribute literal reusable word content, not sentence macros or hidden participant lists. This maximum is a cost bound, not a promise to fill it.
post_selection_development_contract.grammar_cost: At most2additional typed productions and8new explicit participant/scope bindings. No old production or old fixed value changes. Every addition logged before judging the entire completed extension; if parent preservation requires more, stop incomplete.
post_selection_development_contract.multi_step_requirement: The whole new paragraph must link at least two clauses through an explicitly recorded carried material, product or medium and derive a concrete later-use requirement. Merely naming eight known words is insufficient. This is assessed after selection and cannot trigger a replacement target.
post_selection_development_contract.counterversions: Retain a complete FRESH-input rival alongside CARRY wherever the parent licensed it; no invented ALL or NOTHING-LEFT word to remove it. Preserve failed and incomplete attempts. No mixed vocabulary from P05, Galen, clocks or transport.
outcomes: INPUT_MISMATCH or SOURCE_UNCERTAIN: source/capacity issue, no semantic verdict
NO_CAPACITY: no selected whole pair, no gate repair
MISSING_BINDING or COST_LIMIT: complete unfinished draft retained, no contradiction claim
CONTRADICTED_EXACT_CONTRACT: only an explicit fully bound incompatibility rejects that fixed continuation
COHERENT_EXPLORATORY_EXTENSION: unchanged values survive one additional fitted whole reading;0confirmedwords, no significance or reserve access

degrees_of_freedom: The entire parent lexicon/grammar is an unconfirmed development fit.
Twentynewtypes per reader, two new productions and eight bindings are explicit future fitting freedom.
Coverage selection favors the lexical/register distribution of the parent and is not topic-neutral evidence.
Two alternative readers share one manuscript; a both-reader filter can select reader agreement but cannot create independent replication.
Manual entire-clause parsing remains a hypothesis; a coherent output need not be unique.
claim_ceiling: This proposal fixes selection and development costs, not meanings. No test selected or executed by the producer.
